post.summary: Create or reuse a protected guest context without resetting its trial
post.description: Call GET /auth/csrf first; use the same session cookie and synchronizer token. Sets/reuses a separate guest cookie; never returns its token or internal guest ID. A presented invalid/expired guest credential returns 401 GUEST_CREDENTIAL_INVALID, with no replacement context. Explicit X-API-Key is rejected. Reserved/consumed states return 200 here; their 409/401 admission errors belong to conversion submission. Bootstrap: 30/IP/minute; issuance: 5/IP/15 minutes. All responses are no-store. Cookie survives account login/logout; ownership never transfers. Use the guest cookie on conversion submission and status reads. Use the owning guest cookie on protected conversion downloads; expiry/deletion still applies.

post.summary: Validate an upload and durably accept a queued conversion
post.description: Explicit X-API-Key takes precedence and never falls back to cookies. Otherwise use a verified account session or the first-party guest cookie. All responses are no-store. Status reads may use the retained owning guest cookie after login; API keys cannot access guest jobs. Unknown, malformed or unowned IDs return 404. Cookie POST requires exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token from /auth/csrf. Exactly one file and targetFormat; client MIME/extension are untrusted. Static JPG/PNG/WebP/AVIF cross-conversion without same-format output; static GIF and restricted SVG to JPG/PNG/WebP/AVIF; DOCX/ODT/XLSX/PPTX/CSV/TXT to PDF. CSV/TXT require UTF-8 and matching filename extensions; CSV is rectangular comma-separated text with at least two columns and string-only cells. ODT/XLSX/PPTX use bounded package/XML validation; macros, embedded objects and external resources are rejected. XLSX exports visible sheets with local Calc recalculation; PPTX exports visible slides without notes. Office fidelity is not guaranteed. Animated GIF/WebP/AVIF return 422 with ANIMATED_GIF, ANIMATED_WEBP or ANIMATED_AVIF respectively when animation is detected; malformed or otherwise invalid files retain INVALID_FILE. HEIC/HEVC, SVG/GIF output and other pairs are rejected. SVG is UTF-8 XML 1.0 with numeric dimensions and allowlisted geometry only: no text, CSS, transforms, references, entities, DTD or active content. New image metadata validation runs inside a credential-free Linux sandbox before guest reservation, at most one per API process; unavailable isolation returns 503 and concurrent validation 429. Images are limited to 40 million pixels; DOCX to 1000 entries, 80 MB expanded and 200:1 per entry, without encryption, ZIP64, macros, embedded programs or external relationships. Admission: 20/IP/minute, 10/principal/minute, at most 5 active jobs/principal and 1000 globally. Guest eligibility is checked before receiving bytes and atomically reserved at acceptance. HTTP rejection does not consume a trial. A dispatch failure after durable acceptance still returns 202; do not automatically replay an ambiguous upload. The separate worker processes accepted jobs and reconciles durable dispatch intents. Each API process permits four concurrent uploads with a 60-second deadline; rejected or aborted staging files are removed. Excess in-flight uploads return 429 UPLOAD_CAPACITY_REACHED. Capacity release waits for multipart cleanup.

get.summary: Read owned conversion status and result metadata
get.description: Explicit X-API-Key takes precedence and never falls back to cookies. Otherwise use a verified account session or the first-party guest cookie. All responses are no-store. Status reads may use the retained owning guest cookie after login; API keys cannot access guest jobs. Unknown, malformed or unowned IDs return 404. Poll every 1500 ms while queued/processing; stop on completed/failed and back off on request failures. A failed job is HTTP 200 with a safe error, distinct from a failed polling request. Completion persists after result expiry/deletion; resultAvailability indicates access independently. No storage keys or public object URLs are exposed. GET /conversions/{id}/download streams an owned available result; unfinished/failed jobs return 404 and expired/deleted results return 410.

get.summary: Search, filter and page saved outputs
get.description: Account saved outputs only; guests are rejected and invalid explicit keys never fall back to cookies. Responses are no-store. Cookie DELETE requires exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Deleted files immediately become unavailable through both file and conversion download routes. Physical deletion retries asynchronously. Existing streams cannot be recalled.

patch.summary: Rename an owned saved output without changing its extension
patch.description: Updates only originalName metadata; object keys and bytes remain unchanged. Exact existing extension is required. Names are trimmed, 1–200 characters, valid Unicode, without controls, formatting controls or <>:"/\|?*. Guests are rejected; invalid explicit API keys never fall back to cookies. Cookie requests require exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Ownership and availability are checked atomically with the update. Responses are no-store.

post.summary: Read verification of the current session's registration attempt
post.description: Status-only session-bound receipt; never verifies email or authenticates. Wrong-session, missing, expired and invalidated correlations return expired. No arbitrary email/user lookup input. Exact Origin, synchronizer CSRF, API-key rejection and no-store apply. Limited to 30/session/minute and 60/IP/minute plus the global limit. Redis/database failures return 503. Duplicate decoys remain pending until expiry.
